text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 3.8% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 2.9%, suggesting weakness across the major assets. The Fear & Greed index at 29 reflects genuine market anxiety, though the uptick over the past week indicates some stabilization after deeper fear. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 56.4% with $64B in daily volume shows participants aren't fleeing to alts yet, but the broad sell-off across all major coins signals caution is widespread.
